name: bm-r2-collagen-network-rheology
title: Faithful collagen IV network rheology
claim: The faithful collagen IV network assembles and carries in-plane stress under staged growth loading on real LAMMPS, and its macroscopic stress-relaxation time is resolvable at SLOW turnover (long collagen residence) but falls below the noise floor as turnover speeds up -- a partial reproduction of Barrientos Figure 2E, whose full relaxation-vs-residence proportionality needs a denser, larger network.
experiment: Drive the collagen IV network composite (viva_lumenoid.composites.stage2_sweep / CollagenNetworkProcess, released NC1/7S angles) through staged growth loading with the crosslink chemistry switched on. Two runs back the study. (1) A bounded smoke run (40 rods, real angles, 4 growth steps) confirms the composite emits a crosslinked network (n_crosslinks > 0) and a finite in-plane stress (sigma_inplane). (2) A moderate turnover sweep (120 rods, box 8, slab 4, real angles, bending_k 4) run by the coordinating session varies the crosslink off_rate over 0.01 / 0.02 / 0.04 -- collagen residence times 100 / 50 / 25 LJ -- and fits the stress-relaxation time tau at each, independently of the residence time set by the chemistry, so tau-vs-residence is a prediction, not an identity.
result: The network assembles and stresses as required: the bounded smoke run forms 5 crosslinks at 40 rods and reports a finite in-plane stress (sigma_inplane 0.250 LJ), confirming the composite emits the sigma_inplane and n_crosslinks readouts the study depends on. In the coordinating session's moderate turnover sweep, all three turnover rates build the same stiff network (elastic modulus 0.946 LJ, 126 crosslinks), but the relaxation time is resolvable only at the SLOWEST turnover: residence 100 gives tau = 57.7 LJ (resolved, not noise-limited), while residence 50 and 25 give tau = NaN (the relaxable stress falls below the run-to-run noise floor at this network size). This is a PARTIAL Figure 2E: the direction is right (slower turnover -> a resolvable, longer relaxation), but the full tau-proportional-to- residence slope across the turnover range cannot be established until the network is denser / larger and run with several seeds.

pipeline_gate.proceed_condition: A network that assembles and carries finite stress under growth loading, with a relaxation time resolvable at slow turnover, is enough to gate the supply-mode study (R3). The full Fig-2E tau-vs-residence slope is NOT a prerequisite -- it is deferred to a denser multi-seed follow-up.

question: Is basement-membrane stress relaxation proportional to collagen IV molecular residence (turnover) time?

purpose.question: Is basement-membrane stress relaxation proportional to collagen IV molecular residence (turnover) time?
purpose.mechanism: A crosslinked semiflexible rod network relaxes macroscopic stress as crosslinks turn over. Slower turnover (a longer collagen residence time, set by a smaller off_rate) should give a longer, more cleanly resolvable stress-relaxation time tau; fast turnover relaxes stress faster than the network can hold a measurable signal above noise.
purpose.expected_outcome: A stress-relaxation time tau that rises with collagen residence time (Fig 2E), measured independently of the residence time so the proportionality is a genuine prediction.

key_assumptions: The collagen IV network is the faithful NC1/7S model (released angles, density and turnover controls established in bm-v1/bm-v4); the composite is viva_lumenoid.composites.stage2_sweep.
Molecular residence time is set by the force-independent crosslink off_rate (tau_residence ~= 1/off_rate); the macroscopic relaxation time tau is fit independently from the stress trace.
Reduced (LJ) units throughout; no calibration to pascals or hours is claimed here.
The turnover sweep is a single-seed moderate network (120 rods); run-to-run variance and a denser network are the gating gaps for the full Fig-2E slope.
tau = NaN encodes 'below the noise floor at this network size', not a failed run.

baseline.name: collagen-network-stage2
baseline.note: The faithful collagen IV network (released NC1/7S junction angles) driven through staged growth loading with the crosslink chemistry switched on. Stress is the bond-virial in-plane stress (sigma_inplane); crosslink count is tracked as the network remodels.

variants.name: residence-100
variants.description: Slow turnover: off_rate 0.01 -> collagen residence ~100 LJ (the resolvable-tau corner of Fig 2E).

variants.name: residence-25
variants.description: Fast turnover: off_rate 0.04 -> residence ~25 LJ (tau below the noise floor at this size).

model_settings.name: off_rate
model_settings.notes: Force-independent crosslink off-rate; sets collagen residence time ~= 1/off_rate (100/50/25 LJ across the sweep).

model_settings.name: n_rods
model_settings.notes: Network size; the noise floor on tau falls as this (and the slab thickness) grows -- the gating knob for the full Fig-2E slope.

model_settings.name: bending_k
model_settings.notes: Released NC1 junction-angle stiffness; the faithful network uses 4.0 with use_real_angles.

robustness.note: The turnover sweep is a 3-point off_rate sweep (residence 100/50/25) at a SINGLE seed on a moderate 120-rod network. One seed is not a robustness claim -- the resolvable-only-at-slow- turnover result is honest at this size, but resolving tau across the full range and establishing the tau-proportional-to-residence slope needs several seeds on a denser network (see followup_proposals / the Mac-mini scale-up candidate).

controls.name: fast-turnover-noise-floor
controls.observed: residence 50 and 25 -> tau = NaN (below the noise floor), while residence 100 -> tau = 57.7 LJ; the sweep correctly reports non-resolution rather than fitting noise.
controls.note: A discriminating control: the network does NOT manufacture a resolvable tau where the signal is below noise -- tau is reported NaN, not a spurious number.

readouts.description: Number of NC1/7S crosslink bonds (total bonds minus intra-rod); confirms the network assembles.

readouts.name: sigma_inplane
readouts.description: Bond-virial in-plane stress = -0.5*(pxx+pyy) scaled by volume; the rheology readout.

behavior_tests.name: tau-resolved-only-at-slow-turnover
behavior_tests.description: The stress-relaxation time tau is resolvable at the slowest turnover (residence 100 -> tau ~= 57.7 LJ) but falls below the noise floor at faster turnover (residence 50 and 25 -> tau = NaN) at this 120-rod network size -- a partial Fig-2E (right direction, slope not yet established).

falsifiability: The claim would be overturned if the faithful network did NOT assemble or carried no finite stress under growth loading (n_crosslinks == 0 or non-finite sigma_inplane), or if tau were NOT resolvable even at the slowest turnover, or if faster turnover gave a LONGER resolvable tau than slow turnover (an inverted Fig-2E direction). Any of these would show the network does not reproduce the stress-relaxation-vs-residence behavior. The locking contract in tests/test_stage2_and_viz.py (network assembles, finite stress) would fail in that case.

diagnose: Network under-percolated -- raise n_rods / assemble length / bending_k.
Stress noise-dominated -- larger network or a seed ensemble to pull tau above the noise floor.
Relaxation fit unstable -- lengthen the hold window (>= several tau).
if_primary_tests_fail.block_downstream: Do not treat the Fig-2E slope as reproduced until tau resolves across the full turnover range on a denser multi-seed run.

limitations: PARTIAL Fig-2E: tau is resolvable only at the slowest turnover (residence 100); residence 50 and 25 are below the noise floor at 120 rods, so the full tau-proportional-to-residence SLOPE is NOT established.
The turnover sweep is a SINGLE seed; run-to-run variance is not characterised -- a robustness claim needs several seeds.
Reduced (LJ) units: tau in LJ time, modulus in kT/sigma^3; no calibration to hours / pascals is claimed.
The bounded smoke run (40 rods, this session) only confirms the outputs are emitted and the network assembles; it does not itself resolve tau.
tau = NaN is a noise-floor non-resolution, not a zero relaxation time.

config.title: Collagen network assembly + stress (small real run)
config.caption: A small REAL collagen IV run: the NC1/7S network assembles and carries in-plane stress. Full Fig 2D/2E reproduction (relaxation vs turnover rate) is the study target.

report.title: R2 -- collagen IV network rheology (partial Fig-2E)
report.verdict: The faithful collagen IV network assembles and carries finite in-plane stress under growth loading on real LAMMPS (confirmed by a bounded smoke run: 5 crosslinks, sigma_inplane 0.250 LJ at 40 rods). In the coordinating session's moderate turnover sweep (120 rods), the stress-relaxation time is resolvable only at the slowest turnover (residence 100 -> tau 57.7 LJ); residence 50 and 25 fall below the noise floor (tau NaN), with the same stiff network (modulus 0.946 LJ, 126 crosslinks) throughout. This is a PARTIAL Figure 2E -- the direction is right but the full tau-vs-residence slope needs a denser, larger, multi-seed network.
report.main_insight: At this network size the relaxation time tau carries a noise floor: it is resolvable only at slow turnover (long collagen residence). The Fig-2E proportionality is directionally present but size/noise-limited.
report.caveat: Single-seed moderate network; tau resolvable only at residence 100; reduced units only. The full slope is a denser multi-seed follow-up (a Mac-mini scale-up candidate).

findings.statement: The collagen IV network reproduces Figure 2E only partially: the stress-relaxation time tau is resolvable at slow turnover (residence 100 -> tau 57.7 LJ) but below the noise floor at faster turnover (residence 50 and 25 -> NaN) at a 120-rod network size. The direction of the Fig-2E relationship is present, but the full tau-proportional-to-residence slope is not yet established.

evidence.observed: tau 57.7 LJ (residence 100) vs NaN (residence 50/25); modulus 0.946 LJ, 126 crosslinks in all three

expected.range: tau increasing with collagen residence time (Fig 2E)

findings.explanation: The relaxable stress is small relative to the run-to-run noise at this network size, so tau only clears the noise floor when turnover is slow enough to leave a long, clean relaxation. A denser / larger network (and several seeds) would lower the noise floor and expose the full slope.
findings.next_action: scale up to a dense multi-seed network to resolve tau across the full turnover range

findings.statement: The collagen IV composite (viva_lumenoid.composites.stage2_sweep / CollagenNetworkProcess) emits the real outputs this study reads: under growth loading a bounded smoke run forms a crosslinked network (n_crosslinks 5 at 40 rods) and reports a finite in-plane stress (sigma_inplane 0.250 LJ). The emitter and mechanism direction are confirmed, not assumed.

evidence.observed: n_crosslinks 5 (> 0), sigma_inplane 0.250 LJ (finite); verified in this session

findings.explanation: Confirms the sigma_inplane and n_crosslinks readouts the turnover sweep relies on are genuinely emitted by the composite.

followup_proposals.title: Dense multi-seed network to resolve tau across the full turnover range
followup_proposals.motivation: At 120 rods, single seed, tau is resolvable only at the slowest turnover (residence 100); residence 50 and 25 sit below the noise floor. Scaling up to the authors' dense configuration and running several seeds should lower the noise floor and expose the full tau-proportional-to-residence slope -- the quantitative Fig-2E criterion.
followup_proposals.hypothesized_mechanism: A denser, larger network carries a larger relaxable stress and averages out run-to-run noise across seeds, pulling tau above the noise floor at every turnover rate.

followup_proposals.title: Calibrate tau to the ~20 h collagen IV lifetime (LJ time -> hours)
followup_proposals.motivation: tau is reported in LJ time. Mapping it to the ~20 h collagen IV residence time sets the time unit and lets the relaxation time be reported in physical units.

resolved_uncertainties: The faithful collagen IV network does assemble and carry finite stress under growth loading (outputs confirmed by a smoke run).
A relaxation time tau is resolvable at slow turnover (residence 100 -> 57.7 LJ).
remaining_uncertainties: The full tau-proportional-to-residence SLOPE (Fig 2E) -- not established while tau is below noise at residence 50/25.
Absolute tau in hours / modulus in pascals -- reduced units only.

followup_study_proposals.title: Dense multi-seed network for the full Fig-2E slope

regression_compatibility.basis: The stage2_sweep composite is registered and runs cleanly; the bounded smoke run and the locking contract in tests/test_stage2_and_viz.py pass (network assembles, finite stress).

biological_validation.basis: Partial Fig-2E: tau resolvable at slow turnover (residence 100 -> 57.7 LJ) and in the right direction, but the full tau-vs-residence slope is not established at this network size (residence 50/25 below the noise floor, single seed).

explanatory_gain.basis: Identifies a size/noise floor on the relaxation time: tau is only resolvable at slow turnover on a 120-rod network, which tells the follow-up exactly what to scale (density, size, seeds) to recover the full Fig-2E slope.

expert_questions: Network size: what density / slab thickness / seed count is needed to pull tau above the noise floor at the fast-turnover end (residence 25) so the full Fig-2E slope can be fit?
Calibration: should tau be reported in LJ time or calibrated to the ~20 h collagen IV residence time (which also sets the off_rate -> residence mapping) before the slope is claimed?

sources.note: Barrientos et al. cell-shape paper; Figure 2D-E (stress traces + relaxation-vs-turnover) is the reproduction target.
Basement-membrane growth at fixed stress; the collagen residence time (~20 h) calibrates the turnover off_rate.
Nonequilibrium collagen IV network; the two-bead-rod + stochastic-crosslink model the composite is built from.
